label: v028-final-betterbench-standard
notes: Final v0.28 candidate: MXFP4 W4A8 target, tcclaviger FP8 DFlash K7 fast draft, TP2, FP8 KV, 8K/C8, PIECEWISE, prefix cache off; includes shared-parser, DFlash cache-stride, speculative XGrammar, and ROCm current-stream graph backports.

project.resolved_compose:
name: benchmarks
services:
  vllm-radiance:
    cap_add:
      - SYS_PTRACE
    command:
      - /models/Qwen3.8-27B-heretic-ara-fp8-magiccodingman
      - --served-model-name=Qwen3.8-27B-heretic-ara-fp8
      - --quantization=fp8
      - --kv-cache-dtype=fp8
      - --tensor-parallel-size=2
      - --gpu-memory-utilization=0.85
      - --max-model-len=16384
      - --max-num-seqs=8
      - --max-num-batched-tokens=4096
      - --attention-backend=R4D
      - --no-async-scheduling
      - --host=0.0.0.0
      - --port=8000
      - --enable-tokenizer-info-endpoint
      - --enable-auto-tool-choice
      - --tool-call-parser=hermes
      - --language-model-only
    container_name: vllm-radiance-r9700
    devices:
      - source: /dev/kfd
        target: /dev/kfd
        permissions: rwm
      - source: /dev/dri
        target: /dev/dri
        permissions: rwm
    environment:
      AITER_ROOT_DIR: /cache/aiter
      HIP_FORCE_DEV_KERNARG: "0"
      HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES: 0,1
      LMCACHE_CHUNK_SIZE: "256"
      LMCACHE_EXTRA_CONFIG: '{"use_odirect":true,"disk_io_threads":8}'
      LMCACHE_LOCAL_CPU: "True"
      LMCACHE_LOCAL_DISK: file:///cache/lmcache
      LMCACHE_MAX_LOCAL_CPU_SIZE: "24.0"
      LMCACHE_MAX_LOCAL_DISK_SIZE: "500.0"
      NCCL_PROTO: Simple
      RADIANCE_AR_MAX_KB: "49152"
      RADIANCE_AR_QUANT_MIN_KB: "128"
      RADIANCE_ATTN_TUNE: "1"
      RADIANCE_DRAFT_SCHEDULE: 1:8,2:7,4:6,8:5,16:4
      RADIANCE_DRAFT_TAU: "0.28"
      RADIANCE_DYNAMIC_DRAFT: "0"
      RADIANCE_FAST_DRAFT: "1"
      RADIANCE_FUSE_RMS_QUANT: "1"
      RADIANCE_GDN_META: "1"
      RADIANCE_MXFP4: "1"
      RADIANCE_MXFP4_CHECKALL: ""
      RADIANCE_MXFP4_CHECKX: "0"
      RADIANCE_MXFP4_DEBUG: "0"
      RADIANCE_MXFP4_DECODE_MAX_M: "64"
      RADIANCE_MXFP4_KERNEL_N: ""
      RADIANCE_MXFP4_KERNEL_NK: ""
      RADIANCE_MXFP4_PERBLOCK_NK: ""
      RADIANCE_MXFP4_SANITIZE: "0"
      RADIANCE_MXFP4_SYNC: "0"
      RADIANCE_MXFP4_TN4_MIN_M: "2048"
      RADIANCE_MXFP4_W4A8: "1"
      RADIANCE_MXFP4_W4A8_MIN_M: "0"
      RADIANCE_NGRAM_EXTENSION: "1"
      RADIANCE_PRESHUFFLE: "1"
      RADIANCE_QUARK_BF16_MTP: "0"
      RADIANCE_R4D_REPORT: "1"
      RADIANCE_SKINNY_GEMM: "1"
      RADIANCE_TOPK_TRITON_MIN_ROWS: "1"
      RADIANCE_USE_R4D: "1"
      RADIANCE_USE_R4D_AR: "1"
      RADIANCE_USE_R4D_AR_QUANT: "1"
      RADIANCE_USE_R4D_GDN: "1"
      TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_HIPBLASLT: "0"
      TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR: /cache/inductor
      TRITON_CACHE_AUTOTUNING: "1"
      TRITON_CACHE_DIR: /cache/triton
      VLLM_CACHE_ROOT: /cache/vllm
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER: "1"
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4BMM: "0"
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP8BMM: "0"
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_LINEAR: "0"
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MHA: "0"
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MLA: "0"
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE: "0"
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_RMSNORM: "0"
      VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTENTION: "1"
    group_add:
      - "991"
      - "44"
    image: vllm-radiance:v028-final-candidate
    ipc: host
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 8000
        published: "11435"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: 'no'
    security_opt:
      - seccomp=unconfined
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /nvme/lexar-2/ai/models
        target: /models
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
      - type: bind
        source: /nvme/ediloca-1/scratch/vllm-radiance-cache
        target: /cache
        bind: {}
networks:
  default:
    name: benchmarks_default
